description: Agent loop settings shared by all three agents. max_tool_calls: the most tool calls the model may make while answering one prompt; 0 means no limit (a model stuck in a loop then runs until stopped with Ctrl+C). A multi-step task (read a project, change it, build, open a merge request) needs 20 or more. memory_index: the agents' memory index (relative to the repository), loaded into their instructions at start-up; the memory tool maintains it. save_on_exit: when the user types exit in the interactive chat, first give the model one turn to save what is worth remembering (the on_exit prompt in instructions.json); skipped for a session with no tool call and a single exchange, and by Ctrl+C or a --prompt run. names: each agent's name (the identity lines in instructions.json), which it gives when asked.
